result: Added a synthetic Chromium fixture with five measured scroll/layout states. Sixteen-pixel horizontal insets stay clean and genuine two-pixel insets remain cramped. No production rule or exemption changed; the original private-screen observation remains pending.
evidence: `pnpm --filter @syntopica/ui-quality exec vitest run tests/capture/stickyPager.integration.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` passes the actual probe and both rules across all five captures. Targeted ESLint, package type-check, Prettier and diff checks pass. The prior scratch diagnostic independently measured twelve states; no private data or external page was used.
